## Current Research 

### Data Centers & Public Health 

My current research examines the public health impacts, risks, and mitigation approaches associated with data center development and management.

This work brings together evidence from **public health,environmental science, engineering, sustainability, and policy** to better understand how communities can make informed decisions about data center development.

## My Goal
